protocol.name: jev-reader-source-qualified-label-pair-v1
protocol.initialization: Both arms restart from the same original multilingual checkpoint, not the existing 602-state CE model. Seed/order/optimizer/weights/masks/input data are matched within each pair.
protocol.primary_evaluation: Final epoch4 source-reviewed dev acceptance and within-family differences, reported separately for each declared seed. Epoch0/1/2/3 diagnostics never select checkpoint or alter protocol.
protocol.secondary_evaluation: Retain original-label acceptance on the exact same admitted dev states; source-qualified and original metrics remain distinct.
interpretation_limits: This isolates training-target changes on a common admitted subset; it does not estimate benefit of masking or cleaning the entire original 602-state corpus.
Nine effective training families and three labelled dev families are small and dev already exposed; no unseen-generalization or architecture/RL superiority claim.
Source annotations are assistant judgments with preserved qualifications, not independent human adjudication.
No new Reader QA, external benchmark labels, calibration/test loading, service changes or automatic retries.
Training loss curves and prefix acceptance do not establish on-policy QA or whole-pipeline net benefit.

source_qualified.scope: Reference-proof prefix decisions; not Reader QA or net pipeline benefit

limitations: This isolates training-target changes on a common admitted subset; it does not estimate benefit of masking or cleaning the entire original 602-state corpus.
Nine effective training families and three labelled dev families are small and dev already exposed; no unseen-generalization or architecture/RL superiority claim.
Source annotations are assistant judgments with preserved qualifications, not independent human adjudication.
No new Reader QA, external benchmark labels, calibration/test loading, service changes or automatic retries.
Training loss curves and prefix acceptance do not establish on-policy QA or whole-pipeline net benefit.
GPU3 concurrently hosted a sibling training job during part of this cohort; process/compute times are observed shared-device costs, not isolated speed comparisons.
The common 37-state mask is fixed in both arms; this does not measure a masking effect.
Do not choose an intermediate epoch, seed or criterion after inspecting these curves.
interpretation: The two predeclared seeds disagree: source-qualified final acceptance 9→11 and6→5 of22. Seed0 fixes initial useful-evidence opening and one unnecessary continuation; seed1 loses an initial useful open and a sufficient stop while fixing one exhaustion decision. All four still miss the required Gyumri p4 complement on intermediate dev prefixes and generally fail the short Prince-of-Wales sufficiency path. This is not a reliable label-repair learning gain or QA/net-benefit result; do not pick seed0/epoch3 or scale Impact/RL from it.
